subject: free covariances of more then two latent factors

messages.author: 6dbde11635a8e88b
messages.subject: free covariances of more then two latent factors
parts:
Dear group,

I have a simple problem, but I could by no means find a solution. I would like to estimate, for example, a multidimensional Rasch model with three latent factors each measured by 10 items. What I have so far is something like

m <- 'F1 = 1-10
F2 = 11-20
F3 = 21-30
COV=F1*F2
# COV=F1*F3 does not work in combination with previous line
# COV=F1*F2-F3 does not work
# COV=F1*F2,F3 does not work
'
model <- confmirt.model(m)
m1 <- mirt(data, model, itemtype='Rasch')

but I did not find a way to free, i.e., estimate the covariance of f1 and f3 as well as f2 and f3. Am I missing something?

Any suggestions are highly appreciated. Thanks in advance.
